name: Falco Design
website: https://falcodesign.com/ (broken - HTTP 500, browser navigations land on an unrelated casino domain)

customers: Small businesses needing brand identity, print and websites (inference from the service list and studio scale).

agent_readiness.notes: GBP exists with hours (opens 9 AM), phone and the 'Website designer' category, and shows photos, but Maps still offers 'Add missing information'/'Add a photo'. top_opportunities.opportunity: Recover the domain and get a working site back up (or stand up a clean replacement) with portfolio, services, contact and quote form
top_opportunities.evidence: HTTP 500 on direct fetch; a browser navigation from falcodesign.com landed on tr.l-bahiscasino-l.cam

top_opportunities.opportunity: Then repair the Google profile: correct website link, category, services, photos and a review-request loop (3.7 stars)
top_opportunities.evidence: Maps shows 'Add missing information', 'Add a photo' and rating 3.7

scores.reasons: A dead, hijacked-looking domain is the biggest possible gap and an easy pitch, but it is a small design studio with modest budget and the fix requires a rebuild.
